name: KoboldCpp
summary: Self-contained single-executable local LLM, image, and TTS backend powering SillyTavern and local GGUF roleplay with total offline privacy.
ranking_rationale: Zero-telemetry single-file local runner trusted by almost every local-AI roleplayer—unmatched convenience once you pick a GGUF file, limited only by your own VRAM.

pricing.notes: Completely free single binary with zero cloud fees or accounts.

pros: Single executable runs llama.cpp GGUF models with zero Python dependency headaches
Built-in Kobold Lite UI plus instant API backend for SillyTavern
100% offline execution—nothing ever leaves your machine
Supports Vulkan, CUDA, Metal, and CPU offload out of the box
cons: Output speed and intelligence depend entirely on your local GPU/RAM specs
Technical quantization and context-cache toggles confuse absolute beginners

facts.value: Local single-file LLM & multimodal inference runner
Standard backend API for SillyTavern, Agnaistic, and Kobold Lite
